assessment: Material shared least-entry/endpoint argument. Existing private theorem concerns one live state and is a source-level specialization of the new stop-predicate theorem. The old singleton proofs are identical to each other and unchanged. Their direct consumer conversion has not been elaborated in this no-Lean task; publication is not downstream cleanup or a debt waiver.

Material common proof, not a syntax-only false positive: least stop time, strict cut, fixed continuation, and final endpoint. New public theorem generalizes the old Bool/DecidablePred private contracts; new fixed-continuation proof uses public run equations and explicit induction. The two old private proofs remain unchanged, including their Function.iterate_fixed step. This approved prerequisite publication stages downstream MIG re-points; it does not establish that the legacy copies are removed or approve permanent duplication.
